title: Decision requests
summary: Operator questions address project operators, named people, or a live named audience. Explicit recipients can receive organization-scoped questions without a project; audience membership alone grants answer authority. A missing, ended or terminated requesting session refuses with recovery through yoke sessions identity, yoke sessions begin (its help names the required identity fields), then retrying yoke decision-requests ask. The refusal also names yoke doctor run --session for broader machine and session diagnosis. This recovery wording is observed in source and unit tests; deployed proof is pending.
